rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a temporary break or pause in an activity.

example.english: After two hours of meeting, we finally got recess.
example.traditional: 開會開咗兩個鐘，終於有休息時間。
example.jyutping: hoi1 wui2 hoi1 zo2 loeng5 go3 zung1 zung1 jyu1 jau5 jau1 sik1 si4 gaan3

rows.note: Use this when the recess is an official school or institutional holiday rather than a short break during an activity.

example.english: The school has a two-day recess next month.
example.traditional: 學校下個月有兩日假期。
example.jyutping: hok6 haau6 haa6 go3 jyut6 jau5 loeng5 jat6 gaa3 kei4

rows.note: Use this for a brief pause, especially in a work, meeting, or event schedule.

example.english: We scheduled a recess at three this afternoon.
example.jyutping: haa6 zau3 saam1 dim2 on1 paai4 zo2 siu2 jau1
